articles.summary: Orchid Health is the leading rural health provider in Oregon. Named as one of the best places to work in 2021, they specialize in whole-person care, patient relationships, and innovation in rural care. They were named the 2020 Rural Health Hero of the year due in part to their efforts in the communities they serve.
